Give the above link to your friends and anyone you might think could be interested. Your help is greatly appreciated!

notes.title: Bugbyte's new upcoming game Space Haven has a Steam coming soon page!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34134616/f19e086bc0618f4ce3caad4233a7df1b2555a0dd.jpg[/img]

[b]Bugbyte's new upcoming game Space Haven has a Steam coming soon page![/b]

Here is our plan:

[list]
[*] Launch Kickstarter either in February or March 2019. A game build will be available for backers around 2 weeks after Kickstarter ends.
[*] We will develop the game further with the help of feedback from Kickstarter backers and release on Steam once the game is ready.
[/list]

The Kickstarter will be launched in either February or March of 2019 and backers of the Kickstarter will be able to play an early version of Space Haven after the Kickstarter has ended and they have sent us the backers list (Usually takes around 2 weeks). 

[b]Once the campaign launches we will provide links to the campaign on all our social medias, here on Steam, and through the mailing list! There's many options to follow the game at the bottom of the home page:[/b]

http://bugbyte.fi/spacehaven/

Stay tuned :)

After the Kickstarter has ended backers will be able to help us with feedback, and we will iteratively develop the game further.

We hope you are with us and join the first testers of Space Haven through the Kickstarter campaign! Here's what you can do now to not miss the event:

notes.title: New update! A new research tree and bug fixes.
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8xBqlt2.jpg[/img]

Greetings!

Hope everyone has had a good start on 2018. We've been churning on here at Bugbyte and I decided to make more stuff for Sector Siege! This time it's a new research tree with hangar related improvements.

I made a research tree with:

[list]
    [*] Hangar build speed improvement 10%
    [*] Hangar build speed improvement 20%
    [*] Fighter Capture Ray - This laser ray will instantly hack the computer of any enemy fighter, make it attack all your enemies for 30 seconds and then self-destruct.
    [*] Squad size improvement to 2 for all bomber hangars - This will make your bomber hangars able to launch out 2 bomber units at a time from one hangar instead of just 1. This tech is practically a huge boost to your firepower when combined with many bomber hangars.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the new content!

notes.title: New Update! 4 new turrets added to unlockables. Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8xBqlt2.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Commanders!

We want to wish you a merry Christmas in advance with this new update for Sector Siege. The newest version is 1.41 and brings some cool new tech for you to try out.

[b]Below is a list of improvements.[/b]

[list]
[*] New tech tree with 4 new turrets! PD rocket, Ion Plasma, Mega Plasma and Death ray.
[*] Hull repair and shield repair drones defensive behavior distance increased.
[*] Skirmish under siege difficulty with wave amount increased.
[*] Added explanations to special units in unlockables menu.
[*] Fixed marines being refilled for unit when pressing cancel on boarding confirm menu.
[*] Fixed bugs.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: New update! 3 new stations added to unlockables.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/716630/extras/fleetExplosion1.png?t=1508783448[/img]

Good news! 3 new stations arrive to help you defend from incoming attacks. The battlestation from one of the first Battlevoid games makes a cameo. BSE Firstcontact is a point defense specialist station, having 8 pd slots to help you shoot down missiles and fighters.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/716630/extras/customize1.png?t=1508947314[/img]

In addition to the BSE Firstcontact, you now also have the BSE Rampart and BSE Bastion available. These two stations are the big and busky stations, offering a real choice for heavy defense against incoming attacks. This was something that was missing from the human force, but not anymore!

Hope you enjoy the new update.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/716630/

notes.title: Battlevoid: Sector Siege updated!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8xBqlt2.jpg[/img]

Hi there, Commanders!

I have worked hard to make a first update for the game. We would like to invite you to join and play the newest version 1.34 right away!

[b]Below is a list of improvements.[/b]

[list]
[*] Added unit BSE MarineClone and BSE Trademark
[*] Buffed BSE Avallon and BSE Harvesterstation hull and shield.
[*] Made many texts have larger font.
[*] Decreased overall repair cost of units by 20%.
[*] Made endless wave defense difficulty rise more with higher waves.
[*] Disallowed enemy factions warping in with very big fleets in the very beginning of the game.
[*] Difficulty levels tweaked. Easy has more start resources and enemies more penalty for hull and shield. Normal and hard slightly more start resources too. Legend got some more crew.
[*] Possible to Zoom in more 
[*] Unlockables made cheaper
[*] Many bug fixes.
[/list]
